one_liner_zh: 美滿電子EPS小幅超預期1.1%，季度營收逾22億美元顯示AI與資料中心動能延續。
one_liner_en: Marvell narrowly beat EPS by 1.1% with $2.22B revenue, sustaining AI and data-center momentum.
beat_or_miss: 符合預期 / EPS超預期1.05%屬溫和達標（營收年增率未揭露）。
ai_view_zh: 訊號穩健偏正：EPS溫和超預期搭配逾22億美元季度營收，顯示AI與資料中心動能延續，結合次季近28%成長佐證趨勢向上。短期股價中性偏多，營收年增率未揭露使單季判讀有限。中期核心在資料中心與ASIC放量、非AI業務復甦。追蹤指標：資料中心營收年增、ASIC設計案、毛利率、各終端市場走勢與全年指引。
ai_view_en: Signal is steady-to-positive: a modest EPS beat with $2.22B revenue shows AI and data-center momentum continuing, corroborated by the next quarter's ~28% growth. Near-term neutral-to-positive, with undisclosed YoY limiting single-quarter reads. Mid-term the core is data-center and ASIC ramp plus a non-AI recovery. Track: data-center revenue growth, ASIC design-wins, gross margin, end-market trends and full-year guidance.
highlights_zh: EPS 0.80美元，超出預期0.79美元，超預期幅度1.05%
營收22.2億美元，反映資料中心與AI需求持續貢獻
客製化晶片與光通訊業務維持成長動能
產品組合向高成長資料中心傾斜
highlights_en: EPS of $0.80 beat the $0.79 estimate by 1.05%
Revenue of $2.22B reflects continued data-center and AI demand contribution
Custom silicon and optical-connectivity businesses sustain growth momentum
The product mix is tilting toward high-growth data center
risks_zh: 營收年增率未揭露，惟次季顯示近28%高成長
客戶集中與非AI業務（如消費、企業網通）疲弱拖累
risks_en: Revenue YoY not disclosed, though the next quarter shows ~28% growth
A 104x P/E is sensitive to any growth slowdown
Customer concentration and weakness in non-AI segments (consumer, enterprise networking)
